blocked_reasons: The authoritative same-inference RoPE tensors are supplied only as paths and hashes: rope_cos.pt tensor_sha256=69bc611697ee542e26ed17f93ee6b99abe8d51cfaef6f77702969a83c57c13f8 and rope_sin.pt tensor_sha256=187947b91ba8b46b2c1c37f805ae80d49bcd6f1677b9d4ca0f7646d3608bde27. Their values and packed hardware ordering are not included, and there is no authorized runtime-input loader or storage-target contract for them. Harness source is forbidden from reading reference files. Supply immutable materialized cosine/sine words with an explicit token/head-dimension/LSB ordering and DUT loader contract, or supply a trusted synthesizable RoPE implementation proven to reproduce those captured tensors.

The trusted_numeric_support package provides IEEE FP32 add, multiply, divide, square root, compare, and integer conversion primitives, but no trusted synthesizable exponential, sigmoid/SiLU, sine, or cosine implementation. Qwen2 attention softmax, SiLU, and RoPE require those operations. Rule 12 forbids inventing unverified floating-point operators, while rule 11 permits an approximation only if it satisfies the unchanged checker. Supply hash-verified synthesizable transcendental modules, or an authoritative fixed approximation/LUT contract containing coefficients or table values, input-reduction rules, domains, rounding behavior, and error bounds compatible with atol=0.1, rtol=0.1, and max_mismatch_fraction=0.05.

The current RMSNorm template cannot satisfy the declared loader contract even before arithmetic is considered: weightsLoaded is RegInit(true.B), io.weight.ready is driven by !weightsLoaded, and therefore no declared norm-scale write can be accepted after reset. Its datapath also ignores gamma and computes neither mean-square nor reciprocal square root. A manifest claiming tensor hashes 5668398b8ae0b69ebf24d8d1bf05509d8276d3c85be49cfc48a703cda3a91188 and 19cb555eb19556d256504d9f642f577c84b9ad357205105cf535100688f9c222 are consumed would be false without a substantive template repair.

The current self-attention templates are not merely missing an adapter: Attention.scala explicitly returns V after collection, Softmax.scala implements a one-hot maximum, and RoPE.scala implements parity-controlled swaps. Because rule 14 forbids implementing the missing Qwen2 behavior in the wrapper, creating an attention harness around these modules cannot constitute the requested semantic DUT harness.

The current Linear, Elementwise, Activation, and Residual templates treat IEEE fp16/fp32 encodings as signed integers. Binding real checkpoint words to those ports proves writes occurred but does not establish semantic consumption under the frozen IEEE numeric contract. A complete patch therefore requires the missing trusted numeric/transcendental capability rather than a manifest-only repair.

A partial manifest cannot be emitted: agent_manifest_schema requires every current operator-leaf stage, complete tensor-hash coverage, disabled default/identity fallback, and a truthful dut_consumes_bound_weights assertion. Marking status=pass with the current modules would bypass the capability checker contract and is not permitted.
output.root_cause: The immediate capability failure is the missing DUT weight-binding manifest and missing stage harnesses, but the real generated Scala modules cannot currently back a truthful semantic binding: VectorNorm initializes weightsLoaded to true, permanently deasserts its weight ready port, and does not use gamma in RMS normalization; Linear interprets IEEE fp16 activation and weight bit patterns as signed integers and includes an identity default; Attention emits collected V values without QK scoring, causal softmax, or PV computation; RoPE performs a position-parity swap/negation instead of the captured Qwen2 cosine/sine rotation; Activation implements SiLU as negative clipping; ElementwiseMul and ResidualAdd perform integer arithmetic on IEEE encodings; and Softmax is winner-take-all. Correcting these modules requires semantic runtime constants and trusted transcendental support that are not present in the supplied source bundle. A wrapper-side replacement is expressly forbidden, so a bounded compliant implementation cannot be invented from the available evidence.
output.summary: No edits are proposed because the supplied bundle is insufficient to implement a truthful, synthesizable semantic harness for all nine operator-leaf stages under the immutable Qwen2 reference contract. Creating wrappers and a status=pass binding manifest around the current templates would falsely claim semantic weight consumption while several templates demonstrably implement placeholder integer or identity behavior.
